meta.name: Primary Field Rig
meta.description: The physical hardware wired into the two-objective board plus one spare prop LED and one spare haptic motor. This file is theme-neutral on purpose - it is reused unchanged by every theme file.
meta._comment: Edit THIS file when you physically add/move/replace hardware. Do not add game meaning here (no 'alarm_led', no 'team_1_led') - that mapping lives in each theme's hardware_aliases block instead, so the same wire can play different roles in different themes.

leds.location_note: Blue Onboard LED on the ESP32.
leds._comment: Onboard LED, not an external LED, For testing purposes only.

haptics.location_note: Motor embedded in the control console housing
